style.vernacular: Remote Australian island settlement of mixed heritage: a British-colonial "Settlement" at the cove with Singapore/Malaya-derived pale render and louvred veranda houses, a Malay kampong precinct of raised timber houses, Cantonese Poon Saan with Singapore-style units and yellow-and-red Chinese shrines, 1970s aluminium-clad houses at Silver City, all under corrugated iron roofs in rainforest at the foot of limestone cliffs.
style.ornament: Chinese temple red trim, yellow painted shrines with upturned eaves and incense burners in Poon Saan; louvred shutters and verandas on colonial houses; timber lattice and etched glass panels; stilted Malay kampong houses; ordered garden planting along Gaze Road.
